description: This file defines the GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand class, a command-line utility to generate proxy classes using Doctrine ORM within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up configuration, manages database connection parameters, and invokes Doctrine's proxy generation routines.

classes.name: GenerateDoctrineProxiesCommand
classes.description: A console command class that generates Doctrine ORM proxy classes for entity classes in the project.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for console execution, 'orm:generate-proxies'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution logic that sets up Doctrine configuration, creates an EntityManager, retrieves metadata, generates proxy classes, and outputs success message.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves entity paths from plugin configurations for use in ORM setup.
